SyncEnvelope.title: SyncEnvelope
SyncEnvelope.description: Idempotent user-scoped document snapshot with monotonic audit metadata and tombstone support.

payload.description: Domain data payload for the collection record

updatedAtMs.description: Client timestamp of the mutation in milliseconds since epoch

deviceId.description: Unique client installation identity originating the mutation

mutationId.description: Idempotency key uniquely identifying this mutation

deletedAt.description: Optional ISO timestamp indicating tombstone deletion

DomainEventRecord.title: DomainEventRecord
DomainEventRecord.description: Immutable append-only domain event in the remote cloud ledger.

mutationId.description: Matching mutation ID binding the event to the local outbox

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID of the verified event owner

deviceId.description: Client device identifier originating the event

occurredAtMs.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in milliseconds since epoch

eventType.description: Domain event type tag (e.g. session.completed, revision.rated, test.completed, weak_verse.failed, weak_verse.resolved)

/users/{uid}/profile/{documentId}.description: User profile, streak records, and memorization goal

/users/{uid}/plans/{documentId}.description: User memorization plans and preset configurations

/users/{uid}/enginePlans/{documentId}.description: Smart planning engine schedule and active tasks

/users/{uid}/portions/{documentId}.description: SM-2 memorization portions, intervals, ease factors, and repetitions

/users/{uid}/weakVerses/{documentId}.description: Weak verse and repetition focal records

/users/{uid}/tests/{documentId}.description: Assessment question and test score history

/users/{uid}/activityEvents/{documentId}.description: Daily activity logs and session timeline

/users/{uid}/syncMeta/{documentId}.description: Device sync metadata, last sync cursor, and client capabilities

/users/{uid}/events/{eventId}.description: Immutable append-only domain event ledger for multi-device replay and audit
